sentences.japanese: これは格好のよい松の木だ。
sentences.english: This is a well-shaped pine tree.

sentences.japanese: 例えばジャック・パインの松かさは、高温により影響を受けるまでは自ら開いて種子を放出しない。
sentences.english: The cones of the jack pine, for example, do not readily open to release their seeds until they have been subjected to great heat.

sentences.japanese: 彼の家の前には松の木が立っている。
sentences.english: A pine stands in front of his house.

sentences.japanese: 昔私の家の前には大きな松の木があった。
sentences.english: There used to be a big pine tree in front of my house.

sentences.japanese: 高い松の木が湖の周囲を取り囲んでいる。
sentences.english: Tall pine trees form a ring around the lake.
